0x19ab453c.notice: Runs the royalty + access-control module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.admin: The address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` (controls the royalty setters).

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for an ERC-2981 royalty diamond — registers the IERC2981 interface (ERC-165) and seeds AccessControl so the royalty setters are admin-gated. Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open). Companion to the {AccountInit} and {ERC20Init} patterns — a first-class production deploy artifact.
